tasks.short: Compile geological data for environmental issues and potential landfill suitability.

steps.what: Obtain and verify actual environmental site records and their spatial and measurement metadata
inputs: actual environmental question and candidate site ids
actual source-owner geological, sampling and site records
outputs: checked selected site records, provenance and measurement definitions

steps.what: Transfer verified compatible environmental site fields into the separate compilation dataset
inputs: checked selected site records, provenance and measurement definitions
outputs: mapped site compilation fields with explicit incompatible-source exceptions

steps.what: Resolve environmental data comparability, missing evidence and site-specific geological qualifications
inputs: mapped site compilation fields with explicit incompatible-source exceptions
checked selected site records, provenance and measurement definitions
outputs: checked comparable site compilation and actual unresolved limitations

steps.what: Assemble selected environmental comparison tables with checked field and source references
inputs: checked comparable site compilation and actual unresolved limitations

steps.what: Check complete compiled data and write actual qualifications in the retained internal record
inputs: checked comparable site compilation and actual unresolved limitations
outputs: checked saved environmental site compilation with actual qualifications

tasks.design: Transfer verified compatible fields from the actual geological site-record application, OTHER, into the distinct environmental compilation in {DATA_PLATFORM}; configure selected tables in {SPREADSHEET}. Retain actual source capture/verification, comparability decisions and complete qualification records; ordinary same-system saves are ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site fields can be re-keyed into a separate compilation and tables assembled manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic field mapping and native table reuse can reduce those specific operations.
tasks.still_hard: Environmental relevance and site suitability need actual geological interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The technician identifies missing evidence that prevents comparing potential landfill sites fairly.
tasks.altitude: Reduce genuine second-system entry and fixed table assembly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic field mappings and native comparison tables can compile verified environmental site data.

assumptions: Provisional transfer25 is actual manual re-entry into a distinct dataset; table15 removes three repeated layout/reference points. Source owners supply actual site/sample ids, location/reference system, depth, measurement/unit, date and provenance. Technician performs actual source selection, missing extraction and verification within30, and chooses/checks mapping. No free clean site dataset.

Incompatible units, historical methods and missing metadata stay manual in comparability20; final qualification writing/check10 remains. Existing imports/templates get zero credit. Compilation does not approve landfill suitability or issue an external decision. Ordinary saving is fully retained without author self-approval.
unknowns: Which site fields are actually re-keyed and compatible?
research_questions: Can mapping preserve depth, spatial reference and sampling-method differences?

incremental.description: Maintain site field mappings, metadata exceptions and table definitions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 actual transfer plus3 table-assembly points minus1 upkeep=27. Low: incompatible historical site methods need manual reconciliation, leaving only5 compatible current-site transfer points and1 table-reference point removable, minus1=5. Source verification, comparability and full qualification records remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate and interpret seismic data using computers.

steps.what: Verify actual seismic acquisition context, trace quality, units and processing history
inputs: actual seismic traces and acquisition metadata
actual study question and processing history
outputs: checked seismic inputs and actual quality limitations

steps.what: Prepare selected seismic trace panels and comparison displays with checked axes and source references
inputs: checked seismic inputs and actual quality limitations
actual technician-chosen display windows and comparison settings

steps.what: Evaluate and interpret actual seismic data, alternatives, uncertainty and geological implications
inputs: checked seismic inputs and actual quality limitations
outputs: actual checked seismic interpretations and unresolved alternatives

steps.what: Write and check actual seismic interpretation notes and retain supporting trace references
inputs: actual checked seismic interpretations and unresolved alternatives
outputs: checked saved actual seismic interpretation account

tasks.design: Configure selected display layouts, axes and trace-reference reuse in the actual seismic interpretation application, OTHER. Retain quality assessment, display/window selection, all seismic interpretation and actual written qualifications; ordinary internal saves remain ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trace comparison panels and source axes can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved layouts can reduce manual display assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Noise, processing artifacts and nonunique geological interpretations need actual expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognizes an apparent reflector as a processing artifact.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native seismic display layouts can reuse selected panels and axes without replacing geological interpretation.

assumptions: Provisional display15 removes six repeated panel/axis/reference setup points, retaining nine actual window/settings/check points. Acquisition/processing owner supplies actual trace ids, time/depth units, acquisition context and processing revision; technician verifies25 and selects actual settings. Missing or incompatible metadata requires manual display work.

All interpretation50 and actual written findings10 remain. No existing processing runtime, automated horizon pick or inferred resource estimate is credited. Existing saved display layouts get zero new credit. Ordinary save does not acquire an author approval stage.
unknowns: Which comparison displays are still assembled manually?
research_questions: Do saved display settings preserve trace revision and time/depth axes correctly?

incremental.description: Maintain trace display definitions and verify axis/revision compatibility.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes6 repeated display-assembly points minus1 upkeep=5. Low: a noisy survey needs new windows and manual processing-context checks, leaving only2 repeated axis/reference setup points removable, minus1=1. Quality review, settings choices, full seismic interpretation and actual written account remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce compatible site-data transfer and seismic display setup.
skills_to_grow: Maintain trace axes and processing provenance
role.ambitious_version: Compile traceable environmental and seismic context while preserving actual geological interpretation.
